humanState.awaiting: Waiting for a person to confirm

disabled.noVerdict: No automated verdict has been reached for this deliverable yet.
disabled.staleVerdict: Revision {revision} has not been checked yet.
disabled.blocked: {count} citation(s) cannot be verified against the frozen records — revise the draft, then check it again.
disabled.unsavedEdits: Save or discard your edits first.
disabled.alreadyReviewed: This revision is already marked reviewed. Editing it creates a new revision that needs reviewing again.
disabled.notReviewable: This deliverable is not in a state a person can review.

confirm.title: Pass this revision
confirm.subtitle: You are reviewing revision {revision}.
confirm.checkbox: I have read all {count} findings that were not cleared automatically, and confirm this revision can pass.
confirm.impact: Passing marks revision {revision} reviewed and records the time on the deliverable. Nothing is written to any CMS, Git or third-party publishing target — this stage connects to none.

stale.title: The earlier review no longer applies
stale.body: Revision {revision} changed what a customer would read, so this revision needs its own review. The earlier verdict and review are kept as read-only history and are not overwritten.

receipt.title: Review recorded
receipt.body: Revision {revision} is marked reviewed. The review time is recorded on the deliverable. No CMS, Git or third-party publishing write occurred.

blockedReceipt.title: Action refused
blockedReceipt.staleBody: This deliverable already has a newer revision (currently revision {current}). Your review named revision {target}; it was not recorded and nothing changed. Read the new revision and review that instead.

history.title: Full revision history
history.subtitle: Each revision is listed with its timestamp, status, frozen hash, and review decision. This drawer only shows revision records the payload actually returned.
history.empty: This payload has not exposed full revision records yet, so this screen does not invent them.
history.note: The screen no longer compresses current, judged, and brief into a three-row pseudo-history. If a revision record did not arrive, it is stated as missing.

publish.label: Publish to CMS · unavailable at this stage
publish.note: This stage connects to no CMS, Git or third-party publishing target. Passing review produces a reviewed revision and nothing else.

compare.draftFrozenNote: You are reading revision {frozen} — the text this run froze and checked. The deliverable is now on revision {current}, which nothing on this screen has compared against the brief.
compare.noCommittedTopics: The frozen cluster contributed no target keyword, so there is no committed topic list to compare against.
compare.coverageUnevaluated: Coverage was not judged this run, so nothing below is marked either way — compare the two panes by hand.
compare.briefUnavailable: The frozen brief revision could not be read, so only its committed topics are shown.
compare.draftUnavailable: This run has produced no draft body yet.

override.blockedByEditor: Save or discard the draft edits before adjusting the action.
override.overrideDescription: Move this action to a different window, priority, or status. A reason is required and written to the audit trail.
override.overrideKept: Manual overrides are preserved: the next diagnosis will not overwrite this value.
override.reasonHelp: At least 3 characters. Recorded in the audit trail.
override.reasonPlaceholder: Why are you making this change?
override.reasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
override.reasonTooLong: Keep the reason at or under 1000 characters.
override.noteTooLong: Keep the note at or under 4000 characters.
override.noChange: Choose a new status, priority, or window before applying.
override.conflict: This action was changed elsewhere. The queue has been refreshed — review the current values and try again.
override.conflictTransition: That status change is not allowed from the action's current state. Pick a different status.
override.conflictRefreshFailed: The action changed elsewhere and refreshing it failed. Retry to load the current values.
override.noteOptional: Optional — extra context for your team.
override.unsavedLeaveWarning: You have unsaved action adjustments. Leave and discard them?
override.discardDescription: The reason and changes you entered here will be lost.

report.title: Report
report.heroTitle: Turn one evidence set into a report your client can act on.
report.subtitle: The client-facing view of this engagement: coverage, confirmed findings, the 30/60/90 plan, and ready deliverables.
report.executiveSummaryNote: A compact decision frame built only from the confirmed findings, canonical roadmap, and ready deliverables below.
report.evidenceFrameValue: {count, plural, =0 {No confirmed findings are included yet.} one {# confirmed finding anchors this brief.} other {# confirmed findings anchor this brief.}}
report.programShapeValue: {count, plural, =0 {No canonical actions are planned yet.} one {# canonical action is sequenced across the roadmap.} other {# canonical actions are sequenced across the roadmap.}}
report.deliveryStateValue: {count, plural, =0 {No deliverable is ready for handoff yet.} one {# validated deliverable is ready for handoff.} other {# validated deliverables are ready for handoff.}}
report.clientContextNote: The delivery frame below comes from the canonical project configuration for {host}.
report.outputLocaleHelp: This request localizes the methodology and sets the locale for a new export. Clear it to use the project delivery locale. Findings, actions, and deliverables keep their recorded languages, shown below.
report.dataCoverageNote: Coverage reflects which signals were available for this analysis. Unavailable data is never estimated or shown as zero.
report.findingsNote: Confirmed findings, each with a client-readable summary and the key evidence behind it.
report.planNote: Recommended actions organized across the 30 / 60 / 90-day horizon.
report.artifactsNote: Ready execution deliverables prepared for this engagement. Drafts are excluded until finalized.
report.nextStepLead: {count, plural, =0 {Review the canonical roadmap before assigning an execution owner.} one {Approve the # action in the first 30-day lane and assign its owner.} other {Approve the # actions in the first 30-day lane and assign their owners.}}
report.nextStepBody: Keep the evidence references and ready deliverables attached as the work moves from decision to execution.
report.noPromise: This report documents observed signals and recommended actions. It does not predict, guarantee, or promise any ranking, traffic, or revenue outcome.
report.clientBundleNote: The client bundle excludes internal observations, notes, provider usage, ignored or needs-more-data findings, and non-final artifacts. The service bundle contains the full internal record.
report.manifestDescription: Canonical contents and integrity metadata for this generated bundle.
report.clientIncluded: Client-safe report data and ready deliverables
report.clientExcluded: Internal observations, notes, and non-final content
report.serviceIncluded: Canonical service data, observations, evidence, actions, and artifact revisions
report.serviceExcluded: Secrets, credentials, tokens, and restricted provider usage details
report.exportAlreadyActive: An export is already being prepared for this project. Wait for it to finish, then refresh the export status.
report.exportDependencyUnavailable: The export service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
report.exportProtocolError: The export was accepted but no trackable export id was returned. Start the export again.
report.exportProtocolMismatch: The export service answered with a different export than the one being tracked. Start the export again.
report.emptyHint: Run a diagnosis and confirm findings to produce a report.

results.pageLead: Before, after, and attribution boundaries. Review fixed-window GSC, GA4, UTM, target Keyword, and AI-citation evidence by URL while keeping technical rechecks, action receipts, and outcome observations separate.
results.title: Technical recheck record
results.lead: This section verifies the confirmed Action's technical condition only. Traffic, rank, and conversion movement comes from the fixed-window observations above.
results.emptyBody: Run a recheck on a confirmed action to compare its prior and current technical condition here.
results.noRulesBody: The recheck produced no comparable technical rule for this action.

measurement.title: URL results and UTM audit
measurement.lead: A verified Change Receipt separates the 28-day baseline and 28-day outcome windows. URLs remain independent so unrelated pages are never collapsed into a synthetic total.
measurement.recordCount: {count, plural, =1 {# URL record} other {# URL records}}
measurement.errorBody: The technical recheck and client report remain available. Retry the fixed GSC, GA4, and UTM windows.
measurement.emptyBody: After a deliverable is published with a verified Change Receipt, the system waits for a complete outcome window and then shows the observed movement here.
measurement.selectorLead: Choose a URL to switch the evidence, time windows, and metrics shown on the right.

kpi.label: Fixed-window metrics for the current URL

verified.title: Verified
verified.body: Used only for a reproducible technical condition. The current contract does not force the latest project recheck onto the selected URL.

observed.title: Observed
observed.body: Shows movement recorded in fixed windows without attributing it to one article, fix, or publication.

insufficient.title: Insufficient / unavailable
insufficient.body: Limitations remain visible when coverage is insufficient. Unavailable stays unavailable; only a real observed zero is shown as 0.

receipt.title: A receipt is not an outcome
receipt.body: A Delivery Receipt or Change Receipt records an action or verified live change. Outcomes still require an independent recheck or fixed-window observation.

summary.timelineTitle: Verify the action and outcome on separate evidence lines
summary.timelineLead: The left side verifies the live change. The right side records fixed-window observations for the current URL only.
summary.actionTimelineTitle: Action receipt · proves the action occurred
summary.actionReceiptBody: A verified Change Receipt starts the result window but does not prove any metric outcome by itself.
summary.windowComparisonBody: The server freezes both windows; the browser cannot rewrite them or combine different URLs.
summary.observationRecordedBody: The recorded time means the window result was persisted, not that one deliverable caused all movement.

measurement.receiptStartsClock: The Change Receipt starts the result clock; a Delivery Receipt is timeline context only.
measurement.gscDescription: Fixed Google Search Console windows. A smaller average-position value is better.
measurement.ga4Description: Fixed Google Analytics 4 windows, with direct and assisted conversions kept separate.
measurement.geoDescription: Attribution appears only after a verifiable platform, cited passage, and query source are connected.
measurement.nonCausal: These results are observed movement in fixed time windows. They do not claim that one article, code fix, or publication independently caused all movement.
measurement.limitations: {count, plural, =1 {# data limitation} other {# data limitations}}

campaign.title: UTM Campaign before / after
campaign.lead: A phase is totaled only when every listed Campaign for the current URL has a real value in that phase. The table keeps each UTM identity separate and never presents the total as project-wide growth or single-Campaign causation.
campaign.empty: No verifiable UTM Campaign record exists for this window; sitewide traffic is not substituted.

targetKeywordRanks.title: Target Keyword ranks
targetKeywordRanks.lead: Compares only confirmed target Keywords for this URL using DataForSEO absolute rank. GSC average position remains a separate metric above.
targetKeywordRanks.error: Target Keyword ranks are temporarily unavailable. GSC average position and estimates are not substituted.
targetKeywordRanks.emptyTitle: No comparable target Keyword for this URL
targetKeywordRanks.emptyBody: After the Topic Map and page targets are confirmed, real DataForSEO observations enter the before-and-after comparison here.
targetKeywordRanks.limitations: {count, plural, =1 {# rank-data limitation} other {# rank-data limitations}}
targetKeywordRanks.nonCausal: Rank movement is observed across two fixed windows and does not claim that one deliverable independently caused the change.

limitation.noConfirmedTopicMap: No confirmed Topic Map is available, so this page has no governed target Keyword set.
limitation.noConfirmedTargets: No confirmed target Keywords are mapped to this exact page.
limitation.noCompleteComparisons: No target Keyword has a real DataForSEO absolute-rank observation in both measurement windows.
limitation.partialComparisons: Some target Keywords are missing a DataForSEO absolute-rank observation in one or both measurement windows.
limitation.noProviderDataAsOf: DataForSEO absolute rank is compared by collection observation time because the provider does not expose a separate data-as-of timestamp.
limitation.unknown: This rank evidence currently has a data limitation; estimates and ranks from another URL are not substituted.

geoEvidence.lead: Shows real AI queries, platforms, collectors, and direct citation evidence for this URL's fixed before-and-after windows. Missing observations remain unavailable rather than becoming zero.
geoEvidence.error: GEO / AI citation evidence is temporarily unavailable. Mocked or estimated values are not substituted.
geoEvidence.phaseUnavailableBody: This fixed window has no verifiable query and citation snapshot yet.
geoEvidence.phaseSummary: {queries, plural, =1 {# query} other {# queries}} · {citations, plural, =1 {# direct citation} other {# direct citations}}
geoEvidence.noDirectCitation: This observation has no direct citation. A mention or inference is not counted as one.
geoEvidence.structureTitle: Structural differences: cited vs. uncited content
geoEvidence.structureBoundary: Only evidence-bounded observations or inferences are shown; structural differences are not presented as causes of citation.
geoEvidence.nonCausal: These are independent observations from two fixed windows. Structural differences may be evidence-bounded observations or inferences, but cannot explain why a citation occurred or claim that one publication caused the change.
